headline: DA for Tamil Nadu government employees increases from 60% to 63%

top_developments.headline: DA for Tamil Nadu government employees increases from 60% to 63%
top_developments.summary: CHENNAI Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on Saturday (October 31, 2026) announced a hike in dearness allowance (DA) for government employees and teachers, following a similar increase for Central government employees. A State government press release said the DA for Central government employees had been increased from 60% to 63% with effect from July 2026. The revised DA would apply to the Tamil Nadu government employees and teachers with effect from the same date. CHENNAI The Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) Women’s Wing on Saturday (October 31, 2026) staged protests at district headquarters across Tamil Nadu, accusing the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government of failing to maintain law and order, protect women and children, and control the rising cost of essential commodities in the State.

top_developments.headline: Tamil Nadu Congress, VCK mobilise cadres for Nov. 1 INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi
top_developments.summary: CHENNAI Demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, the Tamil Nadu Congress Committee (TNCC) and Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) have activated their respective party machineries to mobilise cadres for the INDIA bloc protest to be held on November 1, 2026, in New Delhi. While the bulk of the heavy lifting would be done by the Indian National Congress, which is much stronger in and around New Delhi, the TNCC leaders, on their part, are expected to mobilise at least 150 people from every district in Tamil Nadu.

- **People will not have faith in a government that cannot protect prisons: Edappadi K. Palaniswami:** People will not have faith in a government that cannot protect prisons: Edappadi K. ([DinaMani](https://news.google.?oc=5))
- **Prisoner escapes from Coimbatore Central Jail:** A prisoner named Raghavan has escaped from the Coimbatore Central Jail complex. Raghavan, who was arrested in Annoor police station in connection with a robbery case, was produced in the court and 4 policemen brought him safely to jail. When the police untied his handcuffs in the jail premises, the police allegedly pushed the four away and fled. All 4 policemen have been suspended for negligence. A robbery accused, who had escaped from Annur police station the previous evening before being recaptured, fled again while being admitted to Coimbatore prison. ([Polimer News](https://www.polimernews.com/districtnews/coimbatore-central-prison-undertrial-prisoner-escapes-12770697))
- **Veterinary assistant surgeon suspended in Villupuram after video of him abusing farmer goes viral:** VILLUPURAM A veterinary assistant surgeon attached to the veterinary dispensary at Koonimedu near Marakkanam in Villupuram district has been placed under suspension after a video of him verbally abusing and threatening a farmer went viral on social media. According to an official, S. Chandru, of Ambedkar Nagar in Koonimedu, had brought his cow to the Koonimedu veterinary dispensary for treatment. When he enquired about the availability of the doctor at the dispensary for subsequent visits, the exchange escalated, with the assistant veterinary surgeon Sankaranarayanan allegedly abusing the farmer. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/veterinary-assistant-surgeon-suspended-in-villupuram-after-video-of-him-abusing-farmer-goes-viral/article71648384.ece))
- **The great escape from Theni jail:** On October 26, a group of 17 remand prisoners hatched a plan to escape from the Theni district jail under the cover of darkness. All of them were apprehended within 42 hours in a massive search operation involving various Tamil Nadu police teams and drones. But the jailbreak has raised larger questions about prison overcrowding, staff shortages, security, and the need for reform, reports L. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/the-great-escape-from-tamil-nadus-theni-jail/article71645449.ece))
- **Kanchipuram: Plantation of 10,000 palm seeds and 400 saplings on the banks of the lake:** In order to protect water bodies and increase the green area in Kanchipuram district, the minister initiated the planting of 10,000 palm seeds and 400 saplings on the banks of Sivankudal lake in Ramanujapuram panchayat. Officials including District Collector Sneha, public and students participated. ([Polimer News](https://www.polimernews.com/districtnews/kanchipuram-lake-bank-10000-palm-seeds-400-saplings-planting-drive-12771539))

- **Gutka scam case: HC directs special court to file report:** The Madras High Court has directed the special court that hears cases against MPs and MLAs to file a report on how the Gutka malpractice case will be investigated and completed within three months. The CBI has registered a case against a total of 26 high-ranking central and state government officials, including ADMK, former ministers CV Vijayabaskar, PV Ramana, former DGP, TK Rajendran, and former Chennai Metropolitan Police Commissioner S. George, for bribing central and state government officials to allow the sale of banned gutka products. The branch manager of this bank, Harsheen Singh, contacted the representative of the owner of the building, Kayalvizhi Alagiri, regarding the repair of the faulty elevator. But because he did not answer properly, Kayalvizhi told Alagiri. In this regard, he has come to the Adyar bank branch and spoken to the branch manager.
